gen-gf-sniglet-gf-barlow: Commanding yet quiet, Sniglet ends its strokes bluntly and holds a level beat. Barlow, drawn like neon tubing with its c tips pulled well apart, carries paragraph after paragraph along in an approachable, unhurried way.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-biz-udpgothic: Flat, single-weight linework gives Sniglet a quiet, level beat and stroke ends that stop before curling. BIZ UDPGothic spaces its letters lavishly, with a clear channel into each round one, so extended reading feels open.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std keeps its counters connected to the outside and swells only slightly in its curves. Make Sniglet small and its level beat loses some of its command.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-commissioner: Terminals that halt before curling inward give Sniglet a quiet, level beat. Commissioner takes over the long reading with smooth curves that never clog, while Sniglet makes the more distinctive entrance.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-didact-gothic: Didact Gothic reads smoothly, with bowls that never close up and strokes that carry the same visual weight. And Sniglet, distinctive and commanding, deserves the bigger size, with Didact Gothic sitting smaller beneath it.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-dotgothic16: Sniglet ends its strokes bluntly, before any inward turn, and keeps a quiet, level beat across the whole heading. DotGothic16 feels tube-like and approachable, wide channels leading into each counter.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-electrolize: Sniglet carries no swelling-and-thinning pulse, only a quiet, level beat. Electrolize, whose open-jawed c looks like a pair of pliers, gives paragraphs a modern, contemporary rhythm from one line to the next.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-elms-sans: Sniglet is distinctive and commanding, its stroke ends stopping before any curl and its beat quiet and level. Elms Sans, a sans drawn with a ballpoint's pressure-free line and a see-through gap in each s, supplies the contrast.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-figtree: Distinctive from the first glance, Sniglet stops its strokes bluntly and holds a quiet, level beat. Figtree, drawn as if with a marker tip and an e that gapes at its terminal, does the contemporary work of reading.
gen-gf-sniglet-gf-fustat: Sniglet's blunt stroke ends and quiet, level beat make it unmistakable. Fustat, whose lines bend like rope or tubing and whose c opens wide, carries extended reading in a contemporary, modern voice.
